Greedy is below the fixed threshold by 23.2 pp at 5% and 8.8 pp at 10%, far outside seed sd, and ties it at 25% and 50%. L7a repeats this at equal labels, and greedy again loses. So the free-label confound is controlled and claim 2 is not_supported, which makes W2 false. For claim 3, every non-E01 entry uses the same Qwen GSM8K majority-vote setup as E01. None reports an embedding AUC gain or neighbor ratio on a different model, task or proxy. Claim 3 is therefore open, not killed, and W3 is false.

G01 compares greedy online (learned) with the plain fixed agreement threshold at matched budgets. The threshold uses no labels, so it has no information advantage. At 10% the learned arm is 8.8 pp below it (5%: 23.2 pp below), so the difference favors the fixed rule. L7a at equal labels agrees: greedy trails the frozen table by 2.06 pp on L2b and 3.35 pp on L4b. Claim 3: only E01 reports embedding statistics (AUC gain about -0.001, neighbor ratio about 1.0). It is the seed entry, and every later run uses the same GSM8K/Qwen/majority-vote setup with no new embedding statistics, so the kill condition is unmet. The confound is controlled, so W2 is false. Claim 3 is not held as supported, so W3 is false.
